svg.text: Jet Ranger cockpit: gauges, lamps and displays, and the controller board that drives each one
Instrument map, A3 landscape. Needles and lamps are drawn at illustrative readings. Cables end at the named connector on the board (references as printed on the PCBs).
HUEY WARNING PANEL (20 caution lamps on MAX7219 digits 4 - 7)
DISPLAYS (4 OLEDs via a TCA9548A multiplexer)
Each board takes real units and does its own calibration.
Legend lamp on a Mega pin
